LESSON: WRITING 2.4.1 CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it necessary to express thoughts and feelings clearly? 2. How can you make your story interesting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. express relevant ideas on a given topic for effective communication,
2. write an open ended composition creatively for self-expression,
3. realise the importance of creativity in writing for effective communication. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
2. Explain Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
4. Show that you can: express relevant ideas on a given topic for effective communication,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is it necessary to express thoughts and feelings clearly? 2. How can you make your story interesting?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. write an open ended composition creatively for self-expression,
3. realise the importance of creativity in writing for effective communication.
